summary: The chart now renders the dedicated `releases` AppProject and both git-generator ApplicationSets per design.md:155-273 — goTemplate with missingkey=error, the configs/prd glob, requeueAfterSeconds: 0, the finalizer, the shared conditional-autoSync templatePatch and all four hook helm parameters — with destinations one glob per registry stage plus argocd-hooks and a cluster whitelist tied to the render. tests/render-chart.py grows AppProject, ApplicationSet and CRD-schema checks over the same 61-object render; 32 mutations each turn it red. `kc project test` and `kc project lint` are green on 20a3266.
